segments.ja60:1.3: Dhantenādhigatā bhogā, te tāto vidhamī dhamanti.
segments.ja60:4.1: Yathā icchiṃ tathāhudakā thalā, sura sāduphalo ca alīnamano;
segments.ja60:4.3: Sampahaṭṭhamano caturo ca tayo, sataladdhaka bhogadhanena dasāti.

lines: Tattha te tāto vidhamī dhamanti te saṅkhaṃ dhamitvā laddhabhoge mama pitā punappunaṃ dhamanto vidhami viddhaṃsesi vināsesīti.
